selection: Minimum declared objective among valid nonnegative splines; no truth-based selection or warm starts between particle counts
ordering: Ascending RMS inlet curvature sqrt(integral(f_second_derivative^2 dy)); operational roughness proxy, not universal complexity
normalization: Data term averaged over particles, so regularization strength relative to per-particle data remains fixed
scope: 50 matched synthetic FEM/analytical-reference fits; one shared noise realization and two optimizer starts per fit; not a confidence-interval or population study
reference_policy: Cached independently mesh-checked FEM at Re30 reused for seven profiles; two new two-mesh FEM references; exact Poiseuille for parabolic. No learned field in observation generation.
heldout_policy: Only first N trajectories enter a fit; inlet truth and reference field excluded; raw files include all six for nested comparisons.
